---
name: slack-api
description: Interact with the Slack Web API to send messages, reply in threads, list and create channels, invite users, fetch channel history, and query workspace members. Use when the user asks to post or automate Slack messages, build Slack bots or notifications, or query/manage Slack workspaces via API tokens.
---

# Slack API

## Overview

Send and retrieve Slack data through the Slack Web API (`https://slack.com/api/`). Use this skill for one-off Slack operations (post a message, list channels, invite users) and for automations that notify or query Slack.

## Prerequisites

- A Slack **token** with the required scopes:
  - Bot token (`xoxb-...`) from a Slack app — preferred for automation
  - User token (`xoxp-...`) for acting on behalf of a user
  - App-level token (`xapp-...`) is for Socket Mode / Events API only, **not** for Web API calls
- Channel references: `#channel-name` works for public channels; otherwise use the channel **ID** (`C...`). Scripts accept both.
- Node.js 18+ (global `fetch`) to run the bundled scripts.

## Quick Start

Send a message to a channel:

```bash
SLACK_TOKEN=xoxb-... node scripts/send_message.cjs C1234567890 "Hello from Gemini!"
```

## Core Tasks

### Send a message

Use `scripts/send_message.cjs` (wraps `chat.postMessage`):

```bash
SLACK_TOKEN=xoxb-... node scripts/send_message.cjs #general "Deploy finished 🎉" \
  --thread-ts 1700000000.000000 \
  --username "Release Bot" \
  --icon-emoji ":rocket:"
```

- `--thread-ts` replies inside an existing thread
- `--username` / `--icon-emoji` override the bot's display name and icon (requires the `chat:write.customize` scope)

### List channels

Use `scripts/list_channels.cjs` (wraps `conversations.list`):

```bash
SLACK_TOKEN=xoxb-... node scripts/list_channels.cjs --types public_channel,private_channel --limit 200
```

Output is truncated to a context-safe length and prints a `next_cursor` when more results exist; pass it with `--cursor` to page.

### Create a channel

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/conversations.create \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"new-channel","is_private":false}'
```

### Invite users to a channel

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/conversations.invite \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"channel":"C1234567890","users":"U111,U222"}'
```

### Fetch channel history

```bash
curl -s "https://slack.com/api/conversations.history?channel=C1234567890&limit=50" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_TOKEN"
```

### List workspace users

```bash
curl -s "https://slack.com/api/users.list?limit=100" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_TOKEN"
```

### Post an ephemeral message (visible only to one user)

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/chat.postEphemeral \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"channel":"C1234567890","user":"U111","text":"Only you can see this"}'
```

## API Notes

- **Response envelope**: every endpoint returns `{"ok": true, ...}` or `{"ok": false, "error": "..."}`. Always check `ok` before trusting data.
- **Scopes** gate access; a missing scope returns `missing_scope`. See [SLACK-API.md](references/slack-api.md) for the endpoint-to-scope table.
- **Pagination**: list endpoints return `response_metadata.next_cursor`; pass it as `cursor` for the next page. Max `limit` is 1000 (200 for `conversations.list`).
- **Rate limits**: Slack applies tiered limits (roughly 1–100+ requests/min depending on plan). On `ratelimited`, retry after the `Retry-After` header.
- **Common errors**: `not_authed`, `invalid_auth`, `channel_not_found`, `user_not_found`, `too_many_attachments`, `invalid_blocks`. Never echo tokens into output.

## Reference

Read [references/slack-api.md](references/slack-api.md) when you need the full endpoint list with required scopes, message formatting (mrkdwn / Block Kit), file uploads, search, pagination details, rate-limit tiers, and troubleshooting.

arguments.content:
# Slack Web API Reference

## Table of Contents

- [Authentication](#authentication)
- [Scopes by Endpoint](#scopes-by-endpoint)
- [Endpoints](#endpoints)
  - [chat.postMessage](#chatpostmessage)
  - [chat.postEphemeral](#chatpostephemeral)
  - [conversations.list](#conversationslist)
  - [conversations.create](#conversationscreate)
  - [conversations.invite](#conversationsinvite)
  - [conversations.history](#conversationshistory)
  - [conversations.info](#conversationsinfo)
  - [users.list](#userslist)
  - [users.info](#usersinfo)
  - [files.upload v2](#filesupload-v2)
  - [search.messages](#searchmessages)
- [Message Formatting](#message-formatting)
- [Pagination](#pagination)
- [Rate Limits](#rate-limits)
- [Errors](#errors)

## Authentication

Send the token in an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header on every request. Bot tokens start with `xoxb-`, user tokens with `xoxp-`. Keep tokens out of URLs, logs, and outputs.

Token types:

| Token | Prefix | Use for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bot token | `xoxb-` | App actions as the bot (recommended) |
| User token | `xoxp-` | Actions on behalf of a user |
| App-level token | `xapp-` | Socket Mode / Events API only, not Web API |

## Scopes by Endpoint

| Endpoint | Bot scopes | User scopes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `chat.postMessage` | `chat:write` (+ `chat:write.customize` for name/icon overrides) | `chat:write` |
| `chat.postEphemeral` | `chat:write` | `chat:write` |
| `conversations.list` | `channels:read`, `groups:read`, `im:read`, `mpim:read` | same |
| `conversations.create` | `channels:manage` | `channels:manage` |
| `conversations.invite` | `channels:manage` | `channels:write` |
| `conversations.history` | `channels:history`, `groups:history`, `im:history`, `mpim:history` | same |
| `conversations.info` | `channels:read`, `groups:read`, `im:read`, `mpim:read` | same |
| `users.list` | `users:read` | `users:read` |
| `users.info` | `users:read` | `users:read` |
| `files.upload` (v2) | `files:write` | `files:write` |
| `search.messages` | `search:read` | `search:read` |

A missing scope returns `{"ok": false, "error": "missing_scope"}` with a `needed` field.

## Endpoints

All endpoints: `https://slack.com/api/<method>`. POST with `Content-Type: application/json` for payloads; GET with query params for reads. Some read endpoints also accept POST.

### chat.postMessage

Sends a message to a channel, conversation, or thread.

Key params: `channel` (required), `text`, `thread_ts` (reply in thread), `username`, `icon_emoji`, `icon_url` (customize requires `chat:write.customize`), `blocks` (Block Kit array), `attachments`, `unfurl_links`, `unfurl_media`, `reply_broadcast` (also post to channel when replying in a thread).

Response: `ok`, `ts` (message timestamp, used as `thread_ts`), `channel`, `message` (full message object with `permalink`).

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"channel":"C1234567890","text":"Deploy finished","thread_ts":"1700000000.000000"}'
```

### chat.postEphemeral

Sends a message visible only to one user in a channel.

Key params: `channel` (required), `user` (required), `text`, `blocks`, `thread_ts`.

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/chat.postEphemeral \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"channel":"C1234567890","user":"U111","text":"Only you can see this"}'
```

### conversations.list

Lists conversations (channels, groups, DMs).

Key params: `types` (comma-separated: `public_channel`, `private_channel`, `mpim`, `im`; default all), `limit` (max 200), `cursor`, `exclude_archived` (default true).

Response: `channels[]` with `id`, `name`, `is_channel`, `is_private`, `is_archived`, `is_member`, `num_members`, `topic`, `purpose`, `previous_names`.

```bash
curl -s "https://slack.com/api/conversations.list?types=public_channel,private_channel&limit=200" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_TOKEN"
```

### conversations.create

Creates a public or private channel.

Key params: `name` (required, lowercase, no spaces), `is_private` (bool), `team_id`.

Response: `channel` object. Error `name_taken` if the name exists.

### conversations.invite

Invites users to a channel.

Key params: `channel` (required), `users` (required, comma-separated user IDs, max 1000).

Errors: `user_not_found`, `already_in_channel`, `cant_invite_self` (bot must be a member first or use `conversations.join`).

### conversations.history

Fetches a conversation's message history.

Key params: `channel` (required), `limit` (max 1000, default 100), `cursor`, `oldest`/`latest` (Unix timestamps), `inclusive`.

Response: `messages[]` (each with `ts`, `user`, `type`, `text`, `blocks`, `thread_ts`, `reply_count`), `has_more`, `response_metadata.next_cursor`.

### conversations.info

Gets metadata about a conversation by ID.

Key params: `channel` (required), `include_num_members` (bool).

Response: `channel` object.

### users.list

Lists workspace users (paginated, max 1000 per page).

Key params: `limit`, `cursor`, `include_locale`.

Response: `members[]` with `id`, `name`, `real_name`, `profile.email`, `profile.display_name`, `is_bot`, `deleted`, `tz`.

### users.info

Gets a user's profile by ID.

Key params: `user` (required), `include_locale`.

Response: `user` object (same shape as `users.list` members).

### files.upload v2

Uploads files to Slack.

Key params: `channels` (comma-separated channel IDs), `file` (multipart file), `content` (text content alternative), `filename`, `title`, `initial_comment`.

```bash
curl -s -F channels=C1234567890 -F file=@report.pdf -F initial_comment="Here is the report" \
  -F token="$SLACK_TOKEN" https://slack.com/api/files.upload
```

Note: v2 returns `file` with a new `id` format (prefix `F`); use `file.id` for references.

### search.messages

Searches messages across the workspace.

Key params: `query` (required, supports modifiers like `in:#channel from:@user before:<date>`), `count` (max 100), `cursor`, `sort` (`timestamp` | `score`), `sort_dir`.

Response: `messages.matches[]` with `channel`, `ts`, `user`, `text`, `permalink`, `blocks`.

## Message Formatting

- **Plain text**: `text` is plain by default; Slack auto-links URLs.
- **mrkdwn** (set `mrkdwn: true` or use in Block Kit text): `*bold*`, `_italic_`, `~strike~`, `` `code` ``, `` ```preformatted``` ``, `>quote`, `<https://example.com|label>` for links, `:emoji:` for emoji, `<!channel>`, `<!here>`, `<!subteam^ID>` for mentions.
- **Block Kit**: pass `blocks` as an array of block objects. Common blocks:
  - `section` with `text` (mrkdwn) and optional `fields`, `accessory`
  - `divider`
  - `header` with plain `text` (max 150 chars)
  - `actions` with `button`/`select` elements
  - `image` with `image_url`, `alt_text`
  - `context` with small text elements
- **User mentions**: use user IDs (`<@U111>`) not names.

## Pagination

Cursor-based. The first request omits `cursor`; the response includes `response_metadata.next_cursor`. Pass that value as `cursor` for the next page. An empty/absent `next_cursor` means no more pages. `has_more` on `conversations.history` also indicates more results.

## Rate Limits

Slack rate limits depend on the app tier and endpoint, roughly 1 to 100+ requests per minute. On exceeding a limit, Slack responds HTTP 429 with `Retry-After` (seconds) and `"error": "ratelimited"`. Back off for the `Retry-After` duration before retrying.

## Errors

Common `error` values in the `{"ok": false, "error": "..."}` envelope:

| Error | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `not_authed` | Missing or malformed Authorization header |
| `invalid_auth` | Token is invalid or revoked |
| `account_inactive` | Token's user is inactive |
| `missing_scope` | Token lacks required scope (see `needed`) |
| `channel_not_found` | Channel ID does not exist or token lacks access |
| `user_not_found` | User ID does not exist |
| `is_archived` | Channel is archived |
| `name_taken` | Channel name already exists |
| `already_in_channel` | User is already a member |
| `invalid_blocks` | Block Kit payload is malformed |
| `too_many_attachments` | Too many legacy attachments |
| `ratelimited` | Rate limit hit; retry after `Retry-After` |

When calling an endpoint directly, always inspect `ok` before using response data.
